verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Literature agent returns high-accuracy, cited responses and Kosmos produces comprehensive cited reports. They also state every conclusion is fully auditable, so any finding can be traced back to the specific literature passage or code that produced it, which directly matches per-claim verification against sources. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that citations actually cover every claim and resolve correctly, and detailed docs on how citations and passage links are presented to the user.
